project_info.color_palette: French tricolor blue, white, red, stone gray, museum-paper cream

main_subject.detail: A flowing French-tricolor silk ribbon crosses a warm off-white paper field; miniature Paris landmarks are sculpted as a bas-relief inside the fabric’s folds.
main_subject.style: Gallery-grade textile realism fused with architectural miniature sculpture

composition_elements.text: PARIS UNFOLDED; A textile journey through the heart of the French capital, where history and cityscapes arise from woven dreams.
items: Across center: blue, white, and red silk ribbon twists in an S curve.
Inside ribbon only: Eiffel Tower, Sacré-Cœur, Notre-Dame and dense Parisian streets as pale sculpted relief.
Lower center: refined serif title and small poetic subtitle.
Background: off-white museum paper with broad negative space.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Tactile folds, subtle sculptural shadows, restrained highlights, elegant depth

assets.name: Paris landmark reference
assets.source: licensed architectural reference or original city art direction
assets.usage: Keep landmark silhouettes recognizable while sculpting them into the ribbon.

prompt_instructions: Attach city landmark reference when a real city is requested.
Keep every architectural detail inside the ribbon boundary.
Use flag colors only as woven fabric, not flat background bands.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: A silk ribbon unfurls diagonally across the canvas, twisting gently in mid-air. Within the folds of the ribbon exists a miniature sculpted city of [CITY], carved as a 3D bas-relief emerging from woven fabric textures. Inside the ribbon: Landmarks, streets, and skyline rhythms of [CITY], flowing naturally with the ribbon’s curvature, layered in subtle depth. Style: Fabric realism fused with sculptural relief. Soft highlights, tactile folds, elegant poster design. Color palette: Derived from the national flag of [COUNTRY], woven seamlessly into the fabric tones. View & background: Top-down minimalist layout, off-white museum paper texture, strong negative space. Typography: Title: “[CITY] UNFOLDED” Refined serif subtitle with poetic geographic language. Composition rules: All architectural detail remains strictly inside the ribbon shape. Ultra-detailed, HDR, gallery-grade, 8K poster aesthetic.
prompt.negative_prompt: landmarks outside ribbon, flat flag stripes, dark background, warped architecture, illegible title, cluttered layout, low resolution, watermark
